title: Ing Siwala Bayu ing Bagyu
intro: Ing metung a pigura keng disyerto tinalakad ya para ausan ne ing metung a mayupayang bangsa pabalik keng katutwan. Kilala la reng tau kareng mangasanting dang gusali at alang kapara a sikanan. Makanyan man ing kayabangan da binulag na la, at e la bisang makiramdam. Kabud-abud, metung a makalunus a parusa ing dinatang karela, a meligtas mung ditak a grupu da ring talasalpantaya.
clues: Mitubud ku karing mayupayang tau a manuknangan king malapad a gabun at pikabaluan king karelang sikanan.
Dinatang la ding memalen ku kaybat ning metung pang maragul a bansa a mesira.
Atin lang mangasanting a istruktura at mitalakad lang matas a tore.
Inaus ku lang samba king Metung a Dios, oneng e ra buring lakuan ding karelang idolo.
Metung a mabagsik a parusa ing dinatang karela, at likuan da la ring kayabe kung meniwala.
Aku ing mitubud karing mayupayang balen a ausan dang Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
